info.title: Token Catalog read-only API
info.description: Independent Material Design 3 token captures and observed changes. Public GET endpoints; no authentication. Source references and contexts should be preserved. Observation dates are not upstream release dates.

get.summary: Export selected tokens or a component implementation
get.description: For content=tokens, use view, set, subject or collection with format=dtcg, css, source or report. View and set accept set; only view applies q. DTCG and CSS include required alias targets. Source JSON groups captured values and references by subject. Send options=1 with the token scope and current choices to discover applicable context.<dimension> parameters and exact values. For content=implementation, use subject (kind=component with a playground) or collection with format=zip. Implementation exports use the catalog Web theme and accept preview.* parameters plus Theme and Contrast. Repeat supported format or context parameters to export up to 64 combinations in a ZIP. Use summary=1 with the intended selection before downloading.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: view exports the filtered table, set exports the whole table, subject exports a whole component or style, and collection exports the whole catalog.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Required for a download. Use zip for implementations. The summary format is a single-selection shorthand.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Subject kind from the subject index. Required outside collection scope.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Subject slug from the subject index. Required outside collection scope.

parameters.name: set
parameters.description: Exact table key for view or set scope, for example md.sys.color. Defaults to the subject's default table.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: For tokens, return the available context dimensions and values for the selection.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: Return selection counts instead of an attachment. Pass the intended formats and contexts for a batch.

200.description: Token document, CSS, conversion report, selection summary, context options, or ZIP archive

400.description: Invalid scope, format, or context, or unavailable implementation

422.description: Required generated CSS assets are unavailable

get.summary: List every component and non-component subject
get.description: No pagination. Follow jsonUrl to fetch one subject with all contexts; slugs can contain slashes. The legacy /api/v1/components index has the same response.

get.summary: Read the current and retained snapshots

get.description: No pagination or server-side filters. Filter records locally by subject or snapshotId. Counts represent records, not unique tokens.

get.summary: Download components, styles or the whole collection

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: styles includes all non-component subject kinds. Every scope includes all supported contexts.

get.summary: Download a filtered table, a whole table or an entire subject
get.description: Use the subject index's jsonUrl as the starting URL. view applies table, search and context filters. set selects the whole table with every supported context and ignores search. all returns every table and context for the subject. Slugs can span multiple path segments.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: view = filtered table; set = whole table, all contexts; all = whole subject, all tables and contexts.

parameters.name: set
parameters.description: Exact table key, for example md.sys.color. Used by view and set. Omission selects the default table.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Token search, applied only for scope=view.

parameters.name: context.Theme
parameters.description: Only applies to scope=view when this table supports Theme. Copy an available value from the HTML form. Omission uses the table default. Other context names may be supported.

parameters.name: context.Platform
parameters.description: Only applies to scope=view when this table supports Platform. Copy an available value from the HTML form. Omission uses the table default. Other context names may be supported.

parameters.name: context.Contrast
parameters.description: Only applies to scope=view when this table supports Contrast. Copy an available value from the HTML form. Omission uses the table default. Other context names may be supported.

parameters.name: context.Audience
parameters.description: Only applies to scope=view when this table supports Audience. Copy an available value from the HTML form. Omission uses the table default. Other context names may be supported.

TokenPresentation.description: Source token-set membership, table hierarchy and display order. A compound typed value remains one token.

value.description: Source-structured JSON, including references or typed compound values; may be null. Do not assume a hex color or scalar.
